wuxia.name: Wuxia
wuxia.tagline: A master of the martial world sizes up your skill
wuxia.speaker: White-Haired Swordsman
wuxia.place: Dueling ground on a misty peak
wuxia.a0.title: Plum Blossom Sword of Mount Hua
wuxia.a0.line1: Your blade goes straight. You don't know how to go around.
wuxia.a0.line2: That stubborn streak will save your life one day.
wuxia.a1.title: Tai Chi Master of Wudang
wuxia.a1.line1: Push and you don't give. Pull and you don't follow.
wuxia.a1.line2: That kind of patience is rare. Don't rush.
wuxia.a2.title: Drifter Like the Wind
wuxia.a2.line1: No sect will ever tie down eyes like those.
wuxia.a2.line2: The road alone suits you better, I'd say.
wuxia.a3.title: Hidden Weapons Expert of the Tang Clan
wuxia.a3.line1: Your head moves before your hands do.
wuxia.a3.line2: It'll be over before they even draw.
wuxia.q1.c1: Draw my sword and walk straight at them
wuxia.q1.c2: Pretend to back off and wait for an opening
wuxia.q1.c3: Take another road. No reason to fight
wuxia.q2: Your master vanished and left one secret manual behind.
wuxia.q2.c1: Compare it with other sects' manuals and find its weak spots
wuxia.q2.c2: Train from page one, every single day
wuxia.q2.c3: Leave it closed until the time is right
wuxia.q3: A quarrel breaks out at the inn.
wuxia.q3.c1: Pay for my drinks and leave quietly
wuxia.q3.c2: Find out who's backing them first
wuxia.q3.c3: Tell them straight to apologize first
wuxia.q4: If you could hold only one weapon, which would it be?
wuxia.q4.c2: An old saber with a chipped edge
wuxia.q4.c3: A dagger hidden in my sleeve
wuxia.q5: Tournament final. Your opponent has hurt his leg.
wuxia.q5.c1: Stay away from the hurt side
wuxia.q5.c2: Take the sure win while I can
wuxia.q5.c3: Forfeit and step down. No fun in a fight like this
wuxia.q6: What name do you want to leave in the martial world?
wuxia.q6.c1: Someone nobody knows, but everyone steps around
wuxia.q6.c2: Someone who stood with the weak
wuxia.q6.c3: Someone no one could read to the end
wuxia.ext.place: Below the mountain, the people who watched you
wuxia.ext1: A murmur rises from below the mountain.
wuxia.ext2: Everyone who saw the duel today will be saying your name for a while.
fantasy.name: Fantasy
fantasy.tagline: The princess finds your place in her palace
fantasy.speaker: The Princess
fantasy.a0.title: Paladin of the Dawn
fantasy.a0.line1: When I stand behind you, I feel safe. I can't explain it.
fantasy.a0.line2: I wish the kingdom had more people like you.
fantasy.a1.title: Archmage Who Reads the Stars
fantasy.a1.line1: Ask you one question and you'd come back with three answers.
fantasy.a1.line2: I'll give you the library key. Just don't stay too late.
fantasy.a2.title: Shadow Scout
fantasy.a2.line1: I didn't even see you come in. How long have you been there?
fantasy.a2.line2: If the palace ever has a secret, I'll call you first.
fantasy.a3.title: Wandering Bard
fantasy.a3.line1: When you speak, everyone turns to look.
fantasy.a3.line2: Please come to the next banquet. Your seat is next to mine.
fantasy.q1: A dragon appears at the castle gate.
fantasy.q1.c1: Raise my shield and stand at the front
fantasy.q1.c2: Look up its weak spot in the library
fantasy.q2: The king wants to give you a secret mission.
fantasy.q2.c1: Tell no one and leave at night
fantasy.q2.c2: Gather my friends and swear an oath first
fantasy.q2.c3: Read the mission records carefully first
fantasy.q3: At the banquet, you spot a poisoned cup.
fantasy.q3.c1: Stop the song so everyone looks my way
fantasy.q3.c2: Quietly follow whoever set the cup down
fantasy.q3.c3: Knock the cup to the floor
fantasy.q4: If you could keep only one?
fantasy.q5: You're lost in a forest, and night falls.
fantasy.q5.c1: Build a fire and guard the group
fantasy.q5.c2: Climb a tree and look around
fantasy.q5.c3: Find the way by the stars
fantasy.q6: If you became a legend, what would the story be?
fantasy.q6.c1: A song everyone sings along to
fantasy.q6.c2: The one who solved a riddle no one could
fantasy.q6.c3: The one who held the castle to the end
fantasy.ext1: The princess opens the balcony door and calls you over.
fantasy.ext2: I'll put a line about today in the court records.
animal.name: Animals
animal.tagline: The forest owl tells you which animal you're like
animal.speaker: Old Forest Owl
animal.place: Under an old tree in the moonlight
animal.a0.title: Wolf Under the Moon
animal.a0.line1: Your eyes get steadier when you're with others.
animal.a1.title: Long-Tailed Fox
animal.a1.line1: You see things before everyone else catches on.
animal.a1.line2: Sometimes it's better to keep that cleverness hidden.
animal.a2.title: Elephant Who Remembers
animal.a2.line1: You hold on to every little thing.
animal.a2.line2: No one near you ever has to worry about being forgotten.
animal.a3.title: Wave-Riding Dolphin
animal.a3.line1: The water changes the moment you show up.
animal.a3.line2: A dull forest needs at least one kid like you.
animal.q1: Heavy rain falls on the forest.
animal.q1.c1: Count to make sure all my friends are here
animal.q1.c3: Go to a cave no one else knows
animal.q2: An animal you've never seen comes closer.
animal.q2.c1: Play a little trick on it first
animal.q2.c2: Watch from far away for a long time
animal.q2.c3: Stand in front of the pack to meet it
animal.q3: You run into an old friend.
animal.q3.c1: Recall every detail from back then
animal.q3.c2: Walk beside them without a word
animal.q3.c3: Shout out loud, I'm so glad
animal.q4: There's only one bite of food left.
animal.q4.c1: Hide it away where no one sees
animal.q6: What if you had to leave the forest?
animal.q6.c1: Go slow so everyone can keep up
animal.q6.c3: Find the shortcut before I go
animal.ext.place: A lakeshore in the dawn mist
animal.ext1: The owl spreads its wings and leads you to the lake.
animal.ext2: Your reflection looks a little clearer than before.
gem.name: Gems
gem.tagline: The jeweler appraises you like an uncut stone
gem.speaker: The Jeweler
gem.place: A small jewelry shop at the end of an alley
gem.a0.title: Blazing Ruby
gem.a0.line1: This red glow is hard to copy.
gem.a0.line2: Keep it close and everything around it warms up.
gem.a1.title: Deep Sea Sapphire
gem.a1.line1: This stone doesn't show its light right away.
gem.a1.line2: The longer you look, the deeper the color gets. Much like you.
gem.a2.title: Forest Emerald
gem.a2.line1: It looks like there's a small garden inside.
gem.a2.line2: Stones like this get better the more they're handled.
gem.a3.title: Unshakable Diamond
gem.a3.line1: From any angle, the lines hold.
gem.a3.line2: This one won't need a certificate.
gem.q1: What catches your eye first in the shop window?
gem.q1.c1: Something that burns red in the light
gem.q2: When you pick out a gift, you...
gem.q2.c1: Take my time and picture their face
gem.q2.c2: Buy it the moment I decide
gem.q3: Someone asks you for an awkward favor.
gem.q3.c1: Think it over for a day, then answer
gem.q3.c3: If it's a no, say no
gem.q4: What if someone gave you a scratched ring?
gem.q4.c1: Wear it as is. The scratch is mine too
gem.q4.c3: Quietly take it in for repair
gem.q5: The lights go out in the shop. You...
gem.q5.c3: Wait for my eyes to adjust
gem.q6: What do you want to keep for a long time?
gem.q6.c3: The first award I ever won
gem.ext1: The owner opens the door to the back workshop for you.
gem.ext2: You're the first customer I've ever shown in here.
